answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Work waits on the island until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the inlet of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The quartz of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
